title: whatsnext configuration
description: One layer of whatsnext settings. Layers, later wins: built-in defaults, user (~/.config/whatsnext/config.json), project (.whatsnext/config.json, committed), project-local (.whatsnext/config.local.json, git-ignored). Every field is optional; a missing field keeps the value from the layer before. `whatsnext config show` prints each effective value and its layer.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor autocomplete.

modules.description: Turn modules on or off. A module that is off adds no hooks and no tokens.

plan.description: PLAN.md, stable IDs, checklist, Start, soft checkout.

progress.description: Progress files (one per task), resume note, freshness check.

paths.description: Where each record lives, relative to the project root. Absolute paths and `..` are rejected.

progress.description: Progress folder: one progress file per task.

plans.description: Captured plan-mode plans, one file per plan (ADR-0006).

handoff.description: The handoff note that `wrap up` writes and the compacts read (ADR-0008). A line `Handoff: <path>` in AGENTS.md names another path when this setting is left at its default.

staleDays.description: The resume note warns that it is stale when the progress file was last updated more than this many days ago.

staleCommits.description: The resume note warns that it is stale when this many commits or more were made since the progress file's recorded commit.

branchOnStart.description: What Start does about the git branch (ADR-0002): ask each time, always create a new branch, always stay on the current branch, or always create a worktree.

staleAfter.description: Idle time after which a checkout goes stale and the holder is asked 'Done, keep or release?' (ADR-0002). Minutes (30m) or hours (4h).

verifyTimeout.description: Longest a `plan done <id> --verify "<cmd>"` command may run before it is stopped and counted as a failure (ADR-0003). Seconds (90s), minutes (30m) or hours (1h).

name.description: Coordination backend that receives events. local-files reads and writes only the repository.
